summary: Current air quality in Pune is Moderate (AQI 120). Prioritize protective indoor safeguards and low-emission choices.

routine.action: Keep standard respiratory protection handy for traffic corridors
routine.why: AQI is 120 (Moderate). Local roadway exhaust can still spike particulate exposure during commutes.
routine.impact: About 30% to 50% particulate reduction for transient roadside exhaust exposures (occupational safety basis).

routine.action: Schedule outdoor physical activities between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM
routine.why: Winter temperature inversions trap heavy smog near ground level in early mornings and late evenings; midday sun promotes dispersion.
routine.impact: About 25% to 40% lower ambient PM2.5 exposure compared to early morning hours (CPCB diurnal curve basis).

routine.action: Conduct hydration and saline nasal rinses after outdoor exposure
routine.why: Particulates dry out the nasal mucosa and irritate upper respiratory passages during winter smog.
routine.impact: Roughly 20% to 30% reduction in mucosal irritation and particulate carriage in upper nasal passages (ENT clinical basis).

routine.action: Cluster any outdoor essential errands into a single midday outing
routine.why: Working from home minimizes transit exposure; combining errands during peak sunlight hours prevents unnecessary smog exposure.
routine.impact: Roughly 40% reduction in daily personal exposure compared to multiple separate trips during peak smog hours (exposure model basis).

indoor.action: Run a mid-capacity True HEPA air purifier continuously in the primary bedroom
indoor.why: True HEPA captures sub-micron combustion particles without producing secondary ozone. Sleeping in clean air aids lung recovery.
indoor.impact: Roughly 75% to 85% reduction in bedroom PM2.5 concentrations in a closed room (standard CADR test basis).

indoor.action: Ventilate briefly for 15-20 minutes only during afternoon hours (1:00 PM - 3:00 PM)
indoor.why: Allows indoor carbon dioxide flush while avoiding high morning and late evening outdoor smog spikes.
indoor.impact: About 30% reduction in indoor CO2 buildup without substantial outdoor PM ingress (controlled natural ventilation basis).

indoor.action: Strictly avoid incense (agarbatti), mosquito coils, and scented candles indoors
indoor.why: Burning one mosquito coil or incense stick generates fine particulate concentrations equivalent to several tens of cigarettes in an unventilated room.
indoor.impact: Avoids adding roughly 100 to 250 µg/m³ of internal PM2.5 load into living spaces (combustion emissions study basis).

swaps.action: Maintain electric induction cooking and clean cooktop surface regularly
swaps.why: Induction cooking emits zero in-situ combustion exhaust (no carbon monoxide or nitrogen dioxide emissions).
swaps.impact: Zero direct combustion byproduct generation inside the residence (appliance emission benchmark basis).

swaps.action: Maintain remote work schedule and replace localized courier deliveries with consolidated neighborhood orders
swaps.why: Eliminates individual commute emissions while reducing delivery vehicle trips in the community.
swaps.impact: About 2 to 4 kg CO2 avoided per avoided daily urban trip (urban mobility baseline basis).

swaps.action: Compost or bag organic garden/kitchen waste; strictly avoid burning dry leaves or trash
swaps.why: Open biomass burning produces dense polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and toxic smoke at ground level during stagnant winter nights.
swaps.impact: Avoids releasing roughly 15 to 30 grams of pure fine particulate matter per small pile burned (CPCB emission inventory basis).
